title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics F

translated_title: 动力学强制：缓解因果视频世界模型中的误差累积
translated_abstract: 因果视频世界模型会基于自身先前的输出逐块进行生成。早期块中的微小错误会作为历史被反馈回来并不断放大，直到场景和机器人完全崩溃。教师强制在干净的真实历史数据上训练，因此模型从未见过它实际会以其为条件的历史，而且模型还会找到一条捷径：复制上一帧而不是预测场景如何变化。我们提出了动力学强制，这是一种训练方案，它保持真实视频作为唯一的监督信号，并重塑历史的呈现方式。历史通过三种方式进行扰动：随机加噪、由模型自身进行的自重采样，以及联合去噪——即在预测下一块时，最近的块仍部分处于带噪状态。在此基础上，我们将历史引导和首帧锚点引导从推理阶段移入训练阶段，从而推动模型利用其历史和参考帧，而不是忽略它们。
tldr: 提出Dynamics Forcing训练方案，通过三种历史扰动方式并将引导机制从推理移入训练，缓解因果视频世界模型自回归生成中的误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that perturbs history through three methods and moves guidance from inference into training to mitigate error accumulation in causal video world models.
